steps.en: Refund advice is sent from OCMS to Cumulus
steps.id: Refund advice dikirim dari OCMS ke Cumulus
steps.why_en: No link to Cumulus exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi ke Cumulus di sistem.

steps.en: OCMS receives success or failure status from Cumulus
steps.id: OCMS menerima status berhasil atau gagal dari Cumulus
steps.why_en: No intake for refund status exists.

steps.en: OCMS gets the failure reason, such as invalid account
steps.id: OCMS menerima alasan gagal, misalnya rekening tidak valid
steps.why_en: Only the reason for creating a refund is stored, not a failure reason.
steps.why_id: Hanya alasan membuat refund yang disimpan, bukan alasan gagal.

steps.en: Officer sees refund status and reason to follow up
steps.id: Officer melihat status dan alasan refund untuk tindak lanjut
steps.why_en: There is nowhere to store or view a payout status.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan atau melihat status pembayaran refund.
